Benfica season|2019–20]] | nextseason = [[2021–22 S.L. Benfica season|2021–22]] }} The 2020–21 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's 117th season in existence and its 87th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. This season, Benfica invested €105 million amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], a record investment in Portuguese football.{{cite news|date=12 February 2021|title=SL Benfica: porque está a falhar o maior investimento da história? Veja o "Jogo Económico"|trans-title=SL Benfica: why is the biggest investment in history failing? Watch "Jogo Económico"|url=https://jornaleconomico.sapo.pt/noticias/sl-benfica-porque-esta-a-falhar-o-maior-investimento-da-historia-hoje-ha-jogo-economico-700300|language=pt|work=O Jornal Económico|access-date=15 February 2021}} Domestically, Benfica lost the [[2020 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira|Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira]] match, were eliminated in the semi-finals of the [[2020–21 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]], finished third in the [[2020–21 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]] – their worst league position since [[2008–09 S.L. Benfica season|2008–09]][https://www.noticiasaominuto.com/desporto/1755308/benfica-repete-terceiro-lugar-no-campeonato-12-anos-depois Benfica repete terceiro lugar no campeonato 12 anos depois] ''Notícias ao Minuto'' – and lost a [[2021 Taça de Portugal Final|Taça de Portugal final]] for a second time in a row.{{cite news|last=Roseiro|first=Bruno|date=23 May 2021|title=Jesus prometeu equipa a jogar o triplo, tornou-se o técnico com mais finais da Taça perdidas e Benfica acabou sem títulos oito épocas depois|trans-title=Jesus promised a team playing three times more, became the coach with the most Cups lost, and Benfica ended trophyless eight seasons later|url=https://observador.pt/2021/05/23/jesus-prometeu-equipa-a-jogar-o-triplo-tornou-se-o-tecnico-com-mais-finais-da-taca-perdidas-e-benfica-acabou-sem-titulos-oito-epocas-depois/|language=pt|work=[[Observador]]|access-date=25 May 2021}} Internationally, Benfica were eliminated in the [[2020–21 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round#Third qualifying round|UEFA Champions League third qualifying round]] and in the [[2020–21 UEFA Europa League knockout phase#Round of 32|round of 32 of the UEFA Europa League]], respectively. The season started on 18 September 2020 and concluded on 23 May 2021. Considered a failed, disastrous season,[https://observador.pt/2021/05/17/para-o-vice-presidente-do-benfica-jesus-tera-de-reganhar-a-confianca-dos-adeptos-jaime-antunes-reconhece-epoca-falhada/ Para o vice-presidente do Benfica, Jesus terá de "reganhar a confiança dos adeptos". Jaime Antunes reconhece "época falhada"] ''Observador''[https://www.abola.pt/nnh/2021-05-24/benfica-os-benfiquistas-tem-de-exigir-que-as-coisas-sejam-alteradas/891479 "Os benfiquistas têm de exigir que as coisas sejam alteradas"] ''A Bola''[https://www.dn.pt/desporto/o-lugar-de-jesus-e-a-contestacao-a-vieira-numa-epoca-desastrosa-13760563.html O lugar de Jesus e a contestação a Vieira numa "época desastrosa"] ''Diário de Notícias'' it was the first time Benfica ended trophyless since [[2012–13 S.L. Benfica season|2012–13]].
